Where little learners grow with confidence
A short journey through our story
Lumikin opened with one bright room and a big idea: learning that feels like play.
More families joined us, and we added our garden and art studio.
New programs for toddlers and pre-schoolers, led by our growing team.
Every day we keep making early learning safe, joyful and inspiring.

See why parents trust us to
nurture happy learners
Lumikin has been a wonderful beginning for our daughter. Every activity grows her curiosity, creativity and kindness, and she has made friendships that fill every day with laughter.
Our son loves every single morning here. The teachers notice the little things, celebrate every step and keep us close to his progress all year.
We were nervous about the first day, but the team made it gentle and happy. Ava now talks about her teachers and friends all the way home.
